verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents comparing sessions that received a context change against held-out sessions, using team-tracked outcomes, with options to keep, revise, or roll back (mirrors-docs-4, mirrors-docs-19, mirrors-docs-5). This is a production holdout comparison for one prompt/context change, not side-by-side comparison of eval runs. Mirrors itself positions evals as a separate concern handled by tools like Braintrust and LangSmith (mirrors-docs-30). missing for 10: side-by-side eval run comparison views, comparison across model versions, offline eval/dataset runs, regression diffing between prompt versions, independent corroboration.
